title: Dwelly completes ninth acquisition with Kensington agency
summary:
Property management group Dwelly has acquired Kensington-based lettings agency Shaws, marking its ninth acquisition in 2026. The deal adds approximately 250 fully managed properties to Dwelly's portfolio, bringing the group's total properties under management to more than 14,000 nationwide.

title: Short-term home moves fall to record low in England
summary:
Only 5% of home sellers in England have owned their property for less than three years, according to research by Connells Group, marking the lowest level on record for short-term residential moves. The figure represents a significant decline from 8% in 2016 and 15% in 2006.

title: Dwelly reaches 14,000 properties with Kensington acquisition
summary:
Property management group Dwelly has reached 14,000 properties under management following its acquisition of Shaws, a Kensington-based letting agency. The deal marks Dwelly's ninth acquisition in 2026, adding 250 properties to its portfolio.

title: Rental market shows signs of stress after Renters’ Rights Act
summary:
Three months after the Renters' Rights Act became law, early market data suggests the legislation may be producing unintended consequences. Goodlord's Rental Index shows rent inflation jumped from 1.7% to 6.5% in June, whilst restrictions on advance rent payments appear to be excluding international students and others without UK guarantors from the rental market.

title: Estate agents show declining trust in political housing policy
summary:
A survey of over 350 estate agents has found that 43% do not trust any political party to address the UK's housing crisis. Despite this scepticism, business confidence among agents has doubled to 16% over the past year.

title: Openmoove offers free material information service
summary:
Property technology company Openmoove has announced it will provide material information services at no cost to estate agents and property sellers, responding to upcoming government reforms to the homebuying process. The company stated that every vendor joining its platform will receive the material information without charge to either party.

title: Specialist lender provides £510,000 for HMO portfolio
summary:
A specialist lender has provided £510,000 to finance the purchase and refurbishment of three houses in multiple occupation across Cumbria and Lancashire. The 12-month facility offers 68% net day one LTV with £110,000 in arrears for refurbishment works.

title: Finance expert calls for first-time buyer support reform
summary:
Financial data group Moneyfacts has called for reforms to support first-time buyers ahead of the Autumn Budget, highlighting concerns that existing schemes have failed to keep pace with rising property prices. Rachel Springall, Finance Expert at Moneyfacts, said the house purchase cap on Lifetime ISAs has remained static since 2017 despite significant property price increases.

title: Foreign-sounding names face mortgage scrutiny, law firm claims
summary:
British citizens and residents with foreign-sounding names are encountering additional scrutiny and delays when attempting to purchase property in the UK, according to a property law firm. Tatiana Sharposhnikova, Chief Executive of Sharpwell Property Law, has stated that discrimination exists in the British property market.

title: Martin & Co franchisee acquires third agency in 12 months
summary:
A Martin & Co franchisee has completed the acquisition of a third lettings agency within a 12-month period, marking continued consolidation within the Worcestershire lettings market. Nirvair Sander, who operates the Martin & Co Worcester franchise, has purchased Parsons Choice, a lettings agency based in Stoke Prior.
